images.caption: La casa de Terracota es una casa hecha de este mismo material, es una casa bella. Lugar turistico de Villa de Leyva. Es una casa totalmente funcional, hay agua, baños, cama, cocina, etc. Todo funciona en la casa. Los visitantes pueden entrar y explorar toda la casa con libertad, la entrada cuesta aproximadamente 3USD. Alrededor de la casa hay otras pequeñas construcciones del mismo material, un pequeño lago, y unos molinos.

images.caption: The mid-16th-century Iglesia de Santo Domingo boasts one of the most richly decorated interiors in Colombia. To the left as you enter is the large Capilla del Rosario, dubbed La Capilla Sixtina del Arte Neogranadino (Sistine Chapel of New Granada's Art). Decorated by Fray Pedro Bedón from Quito, the chapel is exuberantly rich in wonderful, gilded woodcarving – a magnificent example of Hispano-American baroque art.
images.alt: The mid-16th-century Iglesia de Santo Domingo boasts one of the most richly decorated interiors in Colombia. To the left as you enter is the large Capilla del Rosario, dubbed La Capilla Sixtina del Arte Neogranadino (Sistine Chapel of New Granada's Art). Decorated by Fray Pedro Bedón from Quito, the chapel is exuberantly rich in wonderful, gilded woodcarving – a magnificent example of Hispano-American baroque art.

images.filename: Casa del Escribano Juan de Vargas 03.JPG
images.caption: Once home to scribe Juan de Vargas, Casa de Don Juan de Vargas is another splendid 16th-century residence, even richer than Suarez Rendon's one. It also has been converted into a museum and has a collection of colonial artworks on display. Here the most captivating features are the ceilings**, covered with eclectic paintings, jewel of the town's heritage.
